title: Two media agents, one discipline
intro: ADK's model + tools + instruction, and the evaluate-and-retry loop both agents share.

steps.title: The ADK triple
steps.body:
Every ADK agent is **model + tools + instruction**: the model is the brain that decides which tool to call next; tools are functions it invokes autonomously; the instruction (SYSTEM_PROMPT) sets the rules of orchestration.

> [!tip] Tools return **structured JSON** (`response_schema` + Pydantic) — the loop must be able to parse its own state, or it can't act on it.

steps.title: The image agent
steps.body:
Four tools: `brand_analysis` (style guide → visual DNA as JSON), `generate_design_concepts` (brief + DNA → distinct concepts with prompts), `generate_idea_image` (Nano Banana renders, guide attached), `evaluate_image` (LLM judge vs the guide).

The judge scores aesthetics plus the four **CRAP design principles** — Contrast, Repetition, Alignment, Proximity — against a pass threshold, and returns **actionable feedback** that gets folded into the retry prompt (max 1 retry, then a new concept).

steps.title: The video agent's smarter retry
steps.body: `plan_scenes` emits per-scene JSON — `visual_description` (feeds the reference frame), `narration_script` (~20 words ≈ 8 s of speech), `camera_motion`. Then per scene: Nano Banana frame → Veo 8s clip with native audio → `evaluate_scene`.

points.label: Pass ≥3.0
points.note: Next scene. All passing clips concat (ffmpeg) into one continuous explainer.

points.label: Audio fail
points.note: Regenerate the VIDEO only — the reference image was fine, reuse it. Half the cost of a blind retry.

points.label: Visual fail
points.note: Regenerate BOTH image and video — the frame itself missed the plan.

steps.title: Consistency knobs
steps.body:
Defined once, reused everywhere: **`STYLE_PREFIX`** on every image prompt keeps the *visual* style coherent across scenes; **`VOICE_PROFILE`** on every audio prompt keeps the *voice* coherent.

The video judge's criteria add the time dimensions: temporal consistency, motion coherence, **narration alignment** (does the spoken audio match the script?), scene continuity.

recap:
**Generate, judge, retry — with the judge inside the loop.**

- ADK agent = model + tools + instruction; tool I/O is schema'd JSON.
- Image agent: brand DNA → concepts → render → CRAP-judged, feedback-driven retries.
- Video agent: per-scene plan → frame → clip → judge returns a failure TYPE, and the retry regenerates only what failed.
- STYLE_PREFIX and VOICE_PROFILE hold the whole thing together.
